meanings: the Captain of the Torn Cloak (his name at the hearth; the Captain is never named)
derivation: a phrase: canon crenn 'a captain' + canon Covv Treskat 'the Torn Cloak', softened as the possessor of a construct (orrowen_v2 §3.2; c > h, as the canon's S Hrenn, pilot I.1 G7); unit S03 (I.5)

orrowen: Cadhan o hosen re yal cadhat lona
meanings: This we lay as it was laid for us: Halyna's form ('we two lay it as it was laid at us two')
derivation: a phrase: O0234 (Cadhar o hosen re yal cadhat lor) with the pair's own persons, as orrowen_v2 §3.9 item 1 requires (where the Book gives Halyna a plural verb, the Orrowen is dual): Cadhan lay-1DU (cadh + -An, §3.4) + o it(+S) + hosen as + re PST(+S) + yal S·be.PST + cadhat laid + lona at-1DU (§3.6, O1241); unit S03 (II.1). Proposed for every leaf Halyna lay
logogram: TRENN+still (43) + A n · TRENN+still (43) + A t

meanings: the other finishes (it): of a pair speaking one line between them, one beginning it and the other ending it. In full: re vysk hos, eth re dhunn ullen, 'one of them said, and the other finished'
derivation: a phrase: canon tunn 'finish, complete' + ullen 'the other' (ull + -en); the pair's antiphony (orrowen_v2 §3.9 item 5) told from outside, as hos eth ullen 'by turns' (O2858); unit S03 (I.5)

meanings: generation by generation; generation after generation
derivation: a phrase: canon tesk 'a generation' + eth 'and' + tesk, as hos eth hos 'one by one' (O2862); unit S03 (II.1)

meanings: winter after winter; every winter
derivation: a phrase: grem 'winter' + eth 'and' + grem, as hos eth hos (O2862); said where gor grem 'every winter' would soften to gor rem (a softened g drops before a consonant, orrowen_v2 §2.5); unit S03 (II.1)

meanings: one beneath another (names cut down a lintel, stones down a wall)
derivation: a phrase: hos 'one' + ul vimm 'under, beneath' (in the low of) + ullen 'another', its possessor (a vowel, unchanged); unit S03 (II.1)

meanings: at one another; one upon the other (the reciprocal after a verb of seeing: Re vesker hos um ullen, 'we looked at one another')
derivation: a phrase: hos 'one' + um 'upon' (+S; ullen, a vowel, unchanged) + ullen 'the other', as hos eth ullen (O2858); unit S03 (I.5)

meanings: a bonded pair ('a bonded gate': a pair is a gate)
derivation: a phrase: canon ganna 'a gate; a pair (a pair is a gate)' + canon lodhat 'bonded' (lodh + -At); unit S03 (II.1)

meanings: laid in one cradle (of a bonded pair, laid together as infants)
derivation: a phrase: cadhat 'laid' (cadh + -At) + ul 'in' (+N; h unchanged) + hos 'one' + canon tevow 'a cradle'; unit S03 (II.1)
logogram: TRENN+still (43) + A t · ULD+bough (239) + o w

meanings: the Stonwryt coin ('the coin of the Stonwryt')
derivation: a phrase: serull 'a coin, a struck piece' (reserve) + canon Stonwryt, the possessor (s unchanged); unit S03 (II.1)

meanings: the Eldest Haven: Eldhythe's by-name (Eldhythe itself is Tavow Hemm, 'the old landing')
derivation: a phrase: canon cumm 'a haven' + canon hemm 'old' + canon sost 'self, very', for the most (lexicon_orrowen.md §5.3, as mesk hemm sost 'the eldest wood', O1378); unit S03 (II.1)

meanings: more than ('much from'): trenn mest hy dhumol, 'more myth than memory'
derivation: a phrase: mest 'much, many' (reserve) + hy 'from; than' (+S), the comparison of lexicon_orrowen.md §5.3 (strom hy X 'greater than X') and orrowen_v2 §3.6; unit S03 (II.1)

meanings: a master's promise ('the promise of the master'): what the Stonwryt is
derivation: a phrase: tragul 'a promise' (reserve) + et + prass 'a master of the craft', the construct with a definite possessor (the head takes no article, §3.2); unit S03 (II.1)

meanings: owe an answer ('stand surety for an answer'): Tessym tessyl lo et odh sy, 'I owe this hearth an answer'
derivation: a phrase: canon tess 'answer; stand surety for; owe' + tessyl 'an answer' (tess + -Ol); Voss plays on the one word; unit S03 (I.5)

meanings: take back, win back ('hold again'): Es gether pawast gor dholm, 'we will take back every stone'
derivation: a phrase: canon keth 'hold, keep' + canon pawast 'again, a second time' (pa + -Ast); said where grik 'take' would bed to nrik after es or nath (no repair rule for N·gr-, lexicon_orrowen.md §8 item 3); unit S03 (I.5)

meanings: for ice and stone (Voss's question: literally 'for stone and ice'; dem crest would bed to dem grest, 'for harm', so the stone is said first)
derivation: a phrase: dem 'for, for the sake of' (+N) + dolm N·tolm 'stone' + eth 'and' + crest 'ice'; unit S03 (I.5)

meanings: a name to return to ('a name for the homecoming')
derivation: a phrase: canon voll 'a name' + dem 'for' (+N; m unchanged) + mymmyl 'a homecoming, returning' (mymm + -Ol); unit S03 (I.5)

meanings: grey stone; the ridge's own granite ('ash-grey stone'), never tolm myst, which is Myststone
derivation: a phrase: canon tolm 'a stone' + terril 'grey (as ash)' (reserve); unit S03 (II.1)

meanings: on one footing, on the same footing ('upon one deep mortar')
derivation: a phrase: um 'upon' (+S; h unchanged) + hos 'one' + canon lodh gunn 'the footing (the deep mortar)'; unit S03 (II.1)

meanings: of their line, of their lineage ('from their course': a line of names cut one beneath another is a course)
derivation: a phrase: hy 'from' (+S) + so 'their' (+S) + dhrenn S·trenn 'a course; a line'; unit S03 (II.1)

meanings: of their line (of a pair's line): 'from their two's course'
derivation: a phrase: hy 'from' (+S) + sona 'their two' (+S) + dhrenn S·trenn 'a course; a line', as S03-20; unit S03 (II.1)

orrowen: orrol dem vimm dem et cummath
meanings: the going-down to the havens (the eve of the campaign for the havens, I.5)
derivation: a phrase: orrol dem vimm 'the going-down' (O1879) + dem 'to' (+N) + et + cummath 'the havens' (cumm + -Ath); unit S03 (I.5)
logogram: TRENN+course (40) + O l · BRUNN+still (326) · HALD+still (25) + A th

meanings: the later days, the after-days ('the late days')
derivation: a phrase: orlath 'days' (orl + -Ath) + desir 'late, after the time' (reserve); unit S03 (II.1)

meanings: between them ('in their mortar'): what lies between stones
derivation: a phrase: ul lodh 'between' (in the mortar of) with the possessive so 'their' (+S; l unchanged); unit S03 (I.5)
